related.title: Connection Machine CM-5：資料平行分割與尾端負載
related.titleEn: Connection Machine CM-5: data-parallel partitions and tail work
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付鏈結甘特圖、首末元素核對與非鏈結反例；76與44皆正確，首末元素無早於依賴的時刻，模型假設隨圖交付；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver chained timelines, first/last-element checks and an unchained counterexample. Both 76 and 44 match, no element precedes its dependencies, and assumptions accompany the timeline. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 將索引0..102依 i mod P 分配，列各工作者清單與最後索引；另保留來源次序；覆蓋103個索引恰一次，26/14毫秒是這些等成本假設下不含通訊的理想時間。
related.differenceEn: Assign indices 0..102 by i mod P, listing each worker and final index while retaining source order. Cover all 103 indices exactly once; 26/14 ms remain ideal times under the equal-cost, zero-communication assumptions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 長度 n 的串流以一元素每週期前進；理想鏈結兩算子需 s1+s2+n−1 週期，忽略發射衝突；合成加法啟動6週期、乘法7週期，n=64；對照 n=32，同步時鐘且資料已就緒；名義式 6+7+64-1 = 76 cycles；變更式 6+7+32-1 = 44 cycles。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
N筆獨立等成本工作交給P個工作者，最長清單是 ceil(N/P)，完成時間由最大清單而非平均決定；合成 N=103筆、P=8，每筆2毫秒；改P=16，不計傳輸與啟動；名義式 13*2 = 26 ms；變更式 7*2 = 14 ms。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: An n-element stream advances one element per cycle; ideally chained operators take s1+s2+n−1 cycles, ignoring issue conflicts. Synthetic add startup 6, multiply startup 7 cycles, n=64 versus 32, common clock and ready operands. Nominal 6+7+64-1 = 76 cycles; changed 6+7+32-1 = 44 cycles. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

For N independent equal-cost jobs on P workers, the longest list is ceil(N/P); completion follows the maximum rather than the mean. Synthetic N=103, P=8, 2 ms per item; compare P=16 with transfer and startup excluded. Nominal 13*2 = 26 ms; changed 7*2 = 14 ms. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.titleEn: Perlmutter: matching problems to CPU and GPU partitions

related.difference: 畫輸入初始化、常駐裝置、十次核計算、結果回收；copy60已包含所有必要傳輸；100/140、CPU120/240與k8門檻吻合，版本與回收範圍明確。
related.differenceEn: Draw initialization, device residency, ten kernels and final retrieval; copy 60 includes required transfers. Verify 100/140, CPU = 120/240 and threshold 8 with explicit versions/retrieval scope.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。

重用k次的裝置路徑T=copy+k×kernel；一次傳輸可攤薄，但僅限輸入不變；合成copy=60毫秒、kernel=4毫秒，k=10與20；CPU每次12毫秒；名義式 60+10*4 = 100 ms；變更式 60+20*4 = 140 ms。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。

Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

A device path reused k times costs T=copy+k×kernel; amortization requires unchanged inputs. Synthetic copy 60 ms, kernel 4 ms, k 10 versus 20; CPU = 12 ms per iteration. Nominal 60+10*4 = 100 ms; changed 60+20*4 = 140 ms. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
